The new `_from_xarray` calls `window.recompose` whenever a live model window exists, including under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`. `recompose` is not guarded by `is_flat`: an input with a flat `snapshot` index and `period`/`timestep` auxiliary coordinates can therefore have its snapshot index replaced by a MultiIndex before conversion, whereas the base function leaves that input unchanged. This can change the returned pandas index for the same array and component.
